entries.zh: 宣告；公開表明；傳播使眾知。
entries.en: to announce, to make known; to declare publicly.
entries.notes: H 欄「描」讀 biô，與 M/R 欄 pō 不合，於「宣告」義亦無著，疑原稿借字或誤認（當作播／佈）。

entries.zh: 向全鎮（全村）通報；遍告社里民人。
entries.en: to inform the whole town/village; to make known to all the people.
entries.notes: H 欄「描家社甲」與 R 欄音讀（pō guīn siē mīng，似作「播郡社民」）不一致，依 L 欄取「通報全鎮」義。

entries.zh: 稟報；向上級陳告並請示。
entries.en: to report to a superior; to notify and ask leave.
entries.notes: L 欄「ssup.」當為 señor superior（上級）之縮寫，展開屬推斷。

entries.zh: 稟報事情；就某事向上陳報。
entries.en: to report a matter; to give notice of some business.

entries.zh: 書面陳告；呈詞（以文字告知）。
entries.en: to inform in writing; a written statement, a plea.
entries.notes: 「詞」取詞狀、書面陳詞之義以合 avisar por escripto，惟字義與西語僅部分相應。

entries.zh: 呈報；呈遞文書（向上級書面報告）。
entries.en: to submit a document to a superior; to report in writing.

entries.zh: 傳入眾人之口；向人傳告時事、消息。
entries.en: to spread word among people; to bring news to someone.
entries.notes: R 欄「lô xīn kiĕu」與 H 欄「落人口」不對應，M 欄 cheû 近「嘴」，義取「傳言入眾口」。

entries.zh: 謹慎稟報並請准；恭敬向上陳告。
entries.en: to report respectfully and ask permission.
entries.notes: 「ssup.」縮寫展開為上級，屬推斷；H/M/R 三欄互證。

entries.zh: 告稟；向上稟告。
entries.en: to announce; to report to a superior.
entries.notes: L 欄三處標 [删]，僅「告稟」二字可據。

entries.zh: 洩露機密；透露根底（向敵人告密）。
entries.en: to divulge a secret; to betray the inner workings to an enemy.

entries.zh: 傳報；傳達消息、帶話回覆。
entries.en: to carry word; to send a message, to give notice.

entries.zh: 口傳；以口頭傳說告知。
entries.en: to tell by word of mouth; to relate orally.

entries.zh: 傳授（教理）於下手；教導所接觸之人。
entries.en: to hand down doctrine to one's subordinates; to teach those one deals with.
entries.notes: L 欄語句殘缺（「los con quien… con Dõtrina」），義依 H「傳下手」與傳教語境推之。

entries.zh: 傳達並公布聖旨（朝廷命令）。
entries.en: to transmit and publish imperial decrees.

entries.zh: 報告一年風向之轉動；預告季風轉向。
entries.en: to announce the turning of the year's winds; to forecast the monsoon shift.
entries.notes: 「動方」（tāng hōng）指風向轉動，與 L 欄「一年之風」及馬尼拉航行季風語境相合。

entries.zh: 動搖；搖撼人心、局勢。
entries.en: to shake, to sway; to unsettle.
entries.notes: L 欄「delos delsto inventa」殘缺難讀，H/M/R 三欄一致作「動搖」，釋義據漢字欄。

entries.zh: 尚未；還沒。
entries.en: not yet.

entries.zh: 尚未得閒；還沒有空。
entries.en: not yet at leisure; there is no time or opportunity yet.

entries.zh: 現；如今；當前。
entries.en: now; at present.

entries.zh: 現有；現今尚有。
entries.en: there is still; still has.

entries.zh: 還；仍（尚）。
entries.en: still; yet.

entries.zh: 還未；尚未。
entries.en: still not yet; not yet.
